buoyancy-forces.alt: A wooden block held under water by a string. Short pressure arrows push down on its top and longer ones push up on its bottom; side pushes cancel. Its free-body diagram: the buoyant force (water on block) up, longest; the gravitational force (Earth on block) and tension (string on block) down, together balancing it. F_b = ρ_fluid V_disp g.
